data.review_body:
Update 6/24:
I called UniUni this morning and I gave delivery instructions to the agent (basically, leave the package, if questions call me at ########)

The packages for both tracking numbers that had alleged failure attempts of delivery were delivered today, 6/24. This is well within my expectations for delivery timing, but what wasn't ok was sending me failure notices 2 days in a row with faulty info (couldn't contact me??) that asked me to contact the delivery company to avoid having item returned to warehouse. All is fine now, but if this happens again, I will report here. For now I am amending my rating higher.

**********************************************

I have placed two fairly large orders. The first one is just beginninig to be fulfilled and already I sense doom in that the delivery company, ), is claiming they cannot make delivery because there is no one home or the recipient is not answering their calls. No one has been to my home, no one has called about this shipment. But a differeent item in the same first order, different tracking number, was delivered without any interaction at 11pm, same day the faulty shipments (2 of them) could not be delivered due to me not being available...which I was.
I sense the delivery company is stalling about the status of delivery and blaming me, the customer, for not being home when in fact I was. I have a very bad feeling about this....
When I called and talked to someone they said they would email me after the call so I could use the link he was sending to add delivery instructions on my orders. No email came in, there is no way I can find on my own to add delivery instructions. And what would I say? Just deliver the package, no special instruction!

data.review_body: Shein is a place where I can find literally everything, and it makes me come back for more and more. I really love their algorithms which work like a third-eye and recommend me what I wanted to search for. At the same time purchasing something from there is like buying a cat in a bag - loads of comments from buyers are a fluke for points and mostly they show only the package or the appearance of the product. It is ok for some types of them, like, home utensils or clothes, but I'd think twice about buying something from facial care  or makeup categories. And yep, you reap what you sow, so even though I love the design of dresses on the pictures, the quality of fabric is sadly low, which is kind of expected due to the pleasant prices.

data.review_body:
As a longtime customer, I have to say this company is beyond disappointing… I have literally spent thousands of dollars over the years. All of a sudden, approximately five months ago they have blocked my account every time I try to "" unfreeze it I was told there was suspicious activity come to find out there was never any suspicious activity. What happens is when you order bundles of clothing as we all know what are the odds of it fitting so of course you were going to return some of the items which is what I was doing. They decided to simply freeze my account. I have begged and pleaded probably 25 times and every time I submit a ticket or try and get in touch with customer service which we all know it's all AI and there's nobody to actually speak to because they don't even have a customer service number nor do they have a head office with a phone number where you can go complain and ask for help so they ignore you so buyer beware because not only are some of their products arriving damaged. Some items are broken. Some items are not sized properly, the minute you try and send it back they red flag you and then they freeze you out with no explanation. Nobody ever gives you a logical reason or an answer. It's pretty bad when you've been a loyal customer to accompany, but I suppose they must have so many people that one fish in the pond so to speak, they just don't care about even if they let me back on their platform. I won't buy from them just to be treated so poorly for someone who's been as loyal as I haven't spent thousands of dollars it's shameful. Be aware if you make returns you'll get red flag as well.
*******UPDATE!!!*****
This morning I received a notification from SHEIN stating that they had a solution for me… They personally wrote me on my personal email telling me oh we've unblocked and unfrozen your account. It's good to go after spending 45 minutes again today, going back finding all my previous items and put them back in my cart… I went to the checkout and lo and behold. My account is still frozen lol it is so funny how this company plays so many games so because they didn't like my review obviously on Trustpilot because hundreds of thousands of people will look at the reviews, they make it seem like they find a solution. Oh, they become the hero and the minute you read the email and you go try and re-purchase something.… Again, it's just so dishonest they lie about everything. Their customer service is the worst. It's probably AI that's responding to all these complaints about them on Trustpilot… So just so you know nothing has changed. Don't trust them. They'll say anything to try to tease people to get you to go back on Trustpilot to say something in their favor… There's nothing I will ever say in their favor again what a bunch of dishonest, lying people…
